title: Deferred-apply safety layer for cost-tuning advisor (staged shadow + rollback orchestration)
creator: Ava Martinez
description:
Goal: Ship a deferred-apply safety layer around automated batching/caching recommendations so that cost-saving config changes can be applied automatically but never cause undetected SLO regressions. The feature builds on the advisor that suggests batching/caching profiles by adding a conservative execution path: dry-run simulation against live traffic traces, a shadow/staged apply mode (traffic spectator), automated SLO prechecks and live anomaly detectors, an enforceable limiter/safety-brake, and orchestrated rollback hooks. The system must support both hosted and Dedicated deployments and integrate with the rollout control plane (canary windows, percentage ramps, and immediate circuit rollback).

Scope includes: (1) a deferred-apply workflow UI/CLI for Ops/PMs, (2) a traffic spectator surface that runs the proposed config in shadow and produces expected latency/throughput/cost deltas, (3) a set of SLO-aware limiters (per-model and per-tenant) that gate live apply and throttle traffic if P95/P99 drift exceeds thresholds, (4) an anomaly detector tuned for causal changes caused by config apply (change-point + regression tests on prompt-testsets), (5) automated rollback orchestration with audit logging and Post-Apply validation checks.

Out-of-scope: building new batching algorithms or KV cache internals beyond telemetry hooks; those remain in separate performance workstreams.
acceptance_criteria: Advisor can create a deferred-apply artifact (config bundle + validation plan) that can be reviewed before apply
Spectator run produces predictive metrics for latency P50/P95/P99, throughput, qps, cache-hit-rate, and estimated per-token cost delta
Canary/staged apply path enforces SLO gates: abort if P95 increases by >5% absolute or P99 increases by >20% relative to baseline
Automated rollback triggers within 60s of gate violation and returns system to prior config without request loss above baseline error rate
End-to-end test harness demonstrates safe rollback on a synthetic traffic profile (runbook + CI job)
Telemetry emitted to Console: per-rollout timeline, accepted/rejected diffs, root-cause tags, and audit logs
progress_updates: 2025-02-14: Kickoff with PM, Design and Runtime teams. Agreed on deferred-apply artifact format (JSON bundle + validation manifest). - Ava
2025-02-20: PoC spectator run implemented in staging (traffic replay against stored sessions). Early results show predicted P95 delta within 10% of observed after a manual apply. - Daniel
2025-02-27: SLO gate thresholds baked in after SRE review; P95 absolute and P99 relative gates added. Added initial limiter prototype (per-model token/sec cap). - SRE feedback implemented by team
2025-03-03: Integration test failing intermittently under highly bursty traffic; root cause points to race in config hot-reload path. Created ENG-55801 to fix hot-reload race. - Daniel
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Silent regressions if spectator model diverges from production routing. Mitigation: run spectator in two modes (replay and live-shadow) and cross-check results before any live ramp.

Risk: Limiters cause undue throttling and customer-visible errors. Mitigation: conservative default limits, and a soft-throttle mode that keeps tail latency stable while shedding low-priority requests first.
Risk: Rollback produces transient error spikes. Mitigation: orchestrated rollback with graceful draining window + short-lived fallback model variant that keeps availability while state converges.

Risk: False positives from anomaly detector during organic traffic shifts. Mitigation: use contextual detectors (correlate with deployment events and external traffic signals) and require dual-signal confirmation before aborting.
test_plan: Unit tests for deferred-apply artifact parser and validator
Integration tests: line-rate replay in staging with 3 synthetic workload shapes (steady, spiky, bursty)
Canary scenario runs: 0%, 1%, 5%, 20% traffic ramps with SLO gate assertions
Chaos test: simulate node eviction and verify rollback completes within 2 minutes and error-rate stays within 2x baseline for < 5 minutes
CI job: nightly nightwatch which replays a week of anonymized traffic against latest advisor heuristics
deployment_plan: Alpha: feature-flag gated deploy to internal staging cluster with ops-only console UI
Beta: enable for a small set of low-risk customers on Dedicated (opt-in), monitor for 2 weeks
GA: gradual enablement for Hosted API with automatic opt-out for customers with strict SLAs
Backout: manual rollback runbook + automated rollback if SLO gate violated
rollout_criteria: Shadow/spectator predictive error < 10% compared to observed metrics for 3 consecutive days
No critical SRE or customer incidents during beta (severity P0/P1) related to rollout
Dashboarding: per-release comparators available in Console and baseline persisted
Approval from SRE and Product leads
alerts_and_dashboards: Create Console widgets: Rollout timeline, Active deferred-applies, Spectator vs Observed delta (P95/P99)
Alert: Rollout gate breached -> Pager (SRE) + Ops channel (Slack)
Alert: Shadow-observed mismatch > 15% for 1 hour -> Investigate (on-call)
Audit log feed to compliance retention (30 days)
follow_up_tasks: ENG-55801: Fix config hot-reload race (blocking flaky integration tests)
ENG-56012: Add tenant-priority shedding policy for soft-throttle mode
PM-412: Documentation and runbook updates for Ops and Solutions Engineers
notes: Design decision: we chose a deferred-apply instead of full auto-apply by default to preserve predictable SLO behavior for enterprise tenants.
Operational note: implement a short lived fallback model-tag (eg. model:foo@stable) that can be switched instantly if config rollback fails.
Reviewer feedback: Design requested clearer visualization of expected cost savings vs SLO risk; added spectator delta view to mockups.
